## Change

Describe the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue
or compatibility requirement when one exists.

## Validation

List the relevant tests actually run and their outcomes. Identify untested
behavior or remaining blockers. CI binds its results to the tested source;
there is no need to transcribe commit, tree or lockfile hashes here.

## Risks and migration

For changes affecting persistence, authorization, cryptography, external effects
or cluster behavior, explain the failure/recovery and upgrade/rollback impact.
Omit this section for changes where it does not apply.

Compatibility and production claims require evidence for their stated scope.
Do not include real credentials, unseal shares, private keys or production data.
